high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from ndtv.com, dated June 18, 2025, at 5:35 IST (Indian Standard Time). The headline reads: "Positive, Constructive": Foreign Secretary On PM Modi-Mark Carney Meeting. The article discusses the meeting between Prime Minister Narendra Modi of India and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney. According to Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri, the meeting was described as very positive and constructive. The leaders discussed the importance of the India-Canada relationship, which is based on shared values, democracy, the rule of law, people-to-people
